text:
maya: Quick heads-up — small RN tonight targeting 23:00 UTC. Deploybot scheduled for 22:55. Need someone to own pin + internal blurb.
alex: I can own pin. I'll drop draft blurb in #eng-releases by 21:30.
oliver: I'll babysit the canary and watch latency during the window. Ping me at go-time.
sara: RN draft (short): "Ship: reduced memory footprint for runtime; improvements to batching; no user-visible API changes." LMK edits.
maya: Perfect. @alex can you include fallback note + rollback criteria? :eyes: 
alex: Added rollbacks: immediate rollback if 5xx > 3% for 5m OR p99 latency > 2x baseline for 10m. Also include model-pin fallback to v1.3. Code in canary config: `pin_version: "v1.4-canary"`.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled at 2026-03-21T22:55:00Z by @alex. Canary will be 10% for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then 100%.
oliver: Suggest tweak: 10% for 20m given kv-cache warmup. Otherwise fine.
maya: ok adjust to 20m canary. @deploy-bot please update cadence.
deploy-bot: acknowledged — canary updated to 10% for 20m then ramp. Will post heartbeat every 5m.
sara: Added compact internal blurb to draft doc: "Ops standby: @oliver @alex. Rollback triggers listed. See runbook link: https://internal.redwood/release/runbook/9555554321"
alex: Quick confirm: rollback command if triggered:
```
deploybot rollback --release 9555554321 --to v1.3
```
maya: 👍 thumbs up. Who's posting internal announce at cutover?
oliver: I'll post the brief announce and pin the thread.
deploy-bot: deploy starting in 30m. Heartbeat 1/6.
alex: Monitoring dashboards ready, alert thresholds set in pager duty.
sara: small note: update console SN with new metric name `serving.batch_hit_rate`.
maya: Thanks team. If rollback happens, I'll coordinate postmortem. :+1: 
deploy-bot: heartbeat 6/6 — deploy complete to 100%. No immediate anomalies.
oliver: Observability shows p99 +5% for first 10m then stabilized. Closing ops standby in 30m unless issues.
alex: I'll finalize RN copy and send internal announce now.
